category: affiliate site selling Turbobit premium (brand impersonation risk)

free_tier.stated: None sold. The page describes Turbobit's free tier and then sells the premium account.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated on the page read

retention.stated: not stated on the page read

egress.terms: not stated on the page read; only the premium account is described

interface_detail: Marketing pages in Russian and English plus a Turbobit-clone app shell (/ru/turbobit-help.php, /tos.php, /ru/privacy.php).
tooling: Browser. The site links out to rapidgator-premium.net and ddownload-premium.com for its comparison, i.e. its business is premium-account affiliate sales.
chaining: Nothing to chain: it resells a Turbobit account at an unstated price and its own identity is unclear.

limits.value: no price and no payment method is shown before the checkout; the page sells by description only

limits_note: The page asserts 'Turbobit хостинг управляется компанией Công ty TNHH из Вьетнама' (Turbobit is operated by a Vietnamese LLC), which no Turbobit-operated page read states.
binding_note: No constraint could be measured because the record is about who is being paid, not about a quota. The identity question is settled below and is decisive.

identity_cost.detail: The site sells premium access and links to two other premium shops; the actual payee is not identified on any page read, and its claim that Turbobit is run by a Vietnamese company is unsupported by Turbobit's own pages.

reliability_note: A payment here is not a payment to Turbobit.
confidence_note: What remains unknown is the payee - which is exactly why the verdict is not 'qualifies'.

evidence.proved: 'Turbobit хостинг управляется компанией Công ty TNHH из Вьетнама' and the outbound links to rapidgator-premium.net and ddownload-premium.com

notes: Recorded because it ranks for Russian 'turbobit premium' queries and looks like the operator. Candidate explanations considered: (1) it is Turbobit's own Vietnamese-facing brand - contradicted by turbobit.net's own pages, which never name a Vietnamese entity and serve an unrelated app shell; (2) it is an affiliate that bought an expired/typo domain - supported by the clone help pages and the outbound premium-shop links; The record states (2) as the plausible reading and refuses to vouch for the payee.
